function: Excluded, reason system (p. 4): differentially private over-the-air FL aggregation (area 7) over single-antenna WD-to-PS links with scalar channel coefficients h_i, and no RIS.
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Passes checks 1 to 5: research article that jointly designs device sampling, number of training rounds, and the over-the-air transceiver (gradient and artificial-noise powers, receive scaling) for differentially private FL over the air (area 7; OTA FL passes no_learning; the PHY transceiver design is joint with the sampling decision, so above_phy does not apply), evaluated on MNIST and CIFAR-10 (pp. 9-12). Excluded by check 6 (system): p. 4: "The wireless channel coefficient between WD i and the PS is denoted as h_i", and the received signal y_t[d] is a scalar sum estimated with a scalar normalization lambda_t (p. 4); p. 9: free-space path-loss channel where "G_PS = G_D = 0 dB are the antenna gains at the PS and WDs", fc = 915 MHz. No antenna array or beamforming; RIS appears only in related work [6] (p. 1).
